voices.note: the anonymous tanna of the mishna החשוד על הבכורות (29b.4)
anonymous voice of the Gemara on the mishna's clauses

props.gloss_en: one suspect regarding firstborns -- one does not buy deer meat from him
nor [does one buy from him] hides that are not tanned
for it is confused with [the meat] of a calf
hence tanned [hides] we do buy [from him]
were it a firstborn he would not have bothered with it, for he thinks: if the Rabbis hear of it they will make me lose it

supports.gloss_en: בשר צבאים -- דמיחלף בדעגלה: the reason the mishna forbids even deer meat is that it is confused with calf
ולא עורות שאינן עבודים -- הא עבודים זבנינן: inferred from the mishna's wording (kind svara under protest; no kind names a diyuk without דיקא נמי)
אם איתא דבכור הוה לא הוה טרח ביה -- he would not invest in tanning a firstborn's hide, lest the Rabbis hear and he lose it
